rules.statement: The value of the property sold for the purpose of levying fees and poundage should be the amount of the claim and interest.
rules.supporting_quote: "In other words it may be more than Rs. 99,827 if it was necessary for him to bid so high, or if it was not necessary to go up to Rs. 99,827, it must be that sum. Less it cannot be."

meta.parties: The Fiscal (C. P.) v. Nalliappa Chettiar
